q: Rabbits, silly ziggers and zaggers, are so busy in snow that their tracks turn to half-pipes, patterned over and over with lucky footprints, like the path of a giant mole with its roof removed for study.
2002, Barbara McLean, Lambsquarters: Scenes from a Handmade Life, page 281:

e:
Named after the meteorite in which it was found: Zagami Martian meteorite, Katsina State, Nigeria.
Zagami + -ite
